events.mitigation: Pumped high-viscosity tandem sweep. Back-reamed 12 stands with maximum flow rate.
events.outcome: Torque stabilized back to 16 kN.m. Resumed drilling.
events.evidence_quote: At depth 1831.0m in Girujan Clay, severe torque fluctuations (> 28 kn.m) due to hole cleaning deficit and dogleg severity in girujan clays. Action taken: Pumped high-viscosity tandem sweep. Back-reamed 12 stands with maximum flow rate.

events.cause: Encountered high-pressure gas sand stringer in Upper Barail; sudden D-exponent drop and pit gain of 2.4 m3
events.mitigation: Shut-in on annular BOP. Recorded SIDPP=380 psi, SICP=520 psi. Circulated gas bubble via Wait & Weight method. Weighted up mud to 1.44 sg.
events.outcome: Well killed safely after 16 hours. Resumed drilling with zero gas units.
